facts.fact: The Xalam Analytics market brief for the EU-funded D4D Hub (July 2025) names the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2027, built around five focus areas (digital infrastructure, platforms, services, literacy and skills, innovation and entrepreneurship), and the stated period covers the brief's date, which is used as as_of since none other is given. Text public: not stated

systems.owner: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

note: Market brief; states the strategy's period and focus areas only, with no adoption verb, plan, body or report.
